# compliance-authorizer

> Runtime compliance authorization for agentic payments: POST a payment intent,
> get a deterministic, Ed25519-signed allow / deny / review decision with a
> verifiable evidence envelope, driven by a versioned, content-addressed rule
> pack. UNCERTIFIED: the shipped pack is a synthetic demo rule pack — not a
> fatwa / not certified / not production advice; its output is
> committee-reviewable demo evidence.

Rules an agent consuming this API must follow:

- A decision is ALWAYS HTTP 200 — including `deny`. Read `body.decision`,
  never the status code. A 200 does not mean "approved".
- `decision: "deny"` → halt, do NOT retry. The engine is deterministic (no
  LLM, no clock, no randomness): the same intent against the same
  `rule_pack_hash` re-derives the same deny every time.
- `decision: "review"` → halt and escalate to a human. Not a soft allow, not a
  soft deny.
- `decision: "allow"` → proceed; retain `evidence_artifact` (a JWS-compact
  signed envelope, offline-verifiable).
- HTTP 4xx (`application/problem+json`, RFC 9457) = INTEGRATION FAILURE, never
  a decision: no envelope exists, nothing was signed. Fix the request using
  `problem.detail` / `problem.issues`, then resubmit; never reissue the same
  bytes blindly, and never read a 4xx as a deny.
- `reason_codes` is a closed, deterministic set (Shariah v0.1 demo pack:
  MAYSIR, INTOXICANTS, RIBA, GHARAR, MIXED_REVENUE).
- Synthetic data only: never send real card, customer, or personal data.

## Docs

- [Machine contract](docs/machine-contract.md): the normative always-200 /
  problem+json contract with real captured request/response pairs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the condensed agent-facing version with a worked
  deny example
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): clone to first signed decision
  in five minutes
- [Evaluator semantics](docs/evaluator-semantics.md): the pinned deterministic
  evaluation contract (operators, field resolution, conflict resolution)
- [Reproducibility](REPRODUCIBILITY.md): verify authenticity and replay any
  decision offline, trusting nothing
- [Worked example](examples/README.md): a committed, byte-reproducible signed
  deny you can verify and replay without a server
